overview: This paper proposes Re-Schedule, a curriculum learning algorithm for RLVR that uses a novel tree-structural metric (Reasoning Score) derived from approximated reasoning trees to schedule queries from structurally simple to complex during GRPO training, achieving significant accuracy gains on math reasoning benchmarks.

modules.name: Reasoning Tree Construction
modules.description: Build a fixed-structure k-ary approximated reasoning tree for each query by sampling multiple solution trajectories from a base LLM, using periodic branching at every l-token interval with branching factor k and maximum depth d, representing the tree as a triplet (nodes, edges, parent-child relationships).

modules.name: KV-Cache Multi-Path Generation
modules.description: Implement efficient multi-path parallel generation during tree construction by leveraging the KV-cache mechanism, where sibling branches share the same prefix tokens, minimizing computational overhead from repeated sampling of shared prefixes.

modules.name: Node Accuracy Computation
modules.description: Implement the accuracy function that evaluates the quality of any intermediate node by computing the average correctness of its leaf descendants, enabling quality assessment at different levels of the reasoning tree from individual segments to the full query.

modules.name: Node-Level R-Score Calculation
modules.description: For each non-leaf node, compute its local r-score as the maximum accuracy gain achievable by selecting its single best child branch and pruning all others, measuring the local structural learnability at each decision point in the reasoning tree.

modules.name: Query-Level R-Score Calculation
modules.description: Compute the overall r-score for a query by solving the optimization problem of selecting M non-conflicting nodes that maximize the sum of their local r-scores, where two nodes conflict if one lies in a subtree implicitly pruned by the other's optimal branch selection.

modules.name: Dynamic Weight Scheduler
modules.description: Implement the curriculum weighting scheme that assigns adaptive training weights to queries based on both current epoch t and r-score, using either linear or sigmoid scheduling functions that progressively shift priority from high r-score (easy) to low r-score (hard) queries over training.

modules.name: Weighted GRPO Objective
modules.description: Integrate the per-query dynamic weights into the GRPO loss function, modifying the standard objective so that each query's contribution is scaled by its scheduled weight, implementing the rank-based mapping from intermediate alpha values to the final weight range.

modules.name: GRPO Training Loop with Scheduling
modules.description: Implement the main training workflow combining GRPO policy optimization with the Re-Schedule weighting, including group response generation, advantage computation with normalized rewards, epoch management, and weight update progression across training steps.

modules.name: Math Reasoning Data Loading
modules.description: Implement dataset loading and preprocessing for math reasoning tasks (e.g., DAPO-Math-17k), handling integer ground-truth answers, tokenization, and integrating pre-computed reasoning tree metadata and r-scores for efficient scheduling during training.

modules.name: Benchmark Evaluation Pipeline
modules.description: Implement evaluation on multiple math reasoning benchmarks (AIME24, AIME25, AMC23, MATH-500, Minerva Math, OlympiadBench) with appropriate generation settings, using Math-Verify for correctness checking and computing avg@32 across all datasets.

modules.name: MCN Metric Computation
modules.description: Implement the Minimum Corrective Nodes (MCN) metric that measures the minimum number of node modifications required for a reasoning tree to achieve a specified target accuracy, used for analyzing and validating the tree optimization process during training.

modules.name: Ablation Study Framework
modules.description: Implement ablation experiment infrastructure covering tree construction parameters (branching factor k, depth d, token interval l), weighting hyperparameters (omega_min, omega_max), metric comparison (node-Fix vs branch-Pruning), and scheduling direction (easy-to-hard vs hard-to-easy reverse).

modules.name: Sensitivity and Robustness Analysis
modules.description: Implement sensitivity analysis modules for node modification budget M, token interval l across different model capabilities, static vs dynamic r-score updates, and variance analysis across multiple random seeds to assess statistical stability.

modules.name: Configuration and Experiment Management
modules.description: Implement YAML/JSON-based configuration management for all hyperparameters (tree structure, scheduling scheme, weight range, training settings), supporting experiment configuration inheritance, reproducibility, and systematic hyperparameter sweep coordination.

modules.name: Computational Cost and Result Reporting
modules.description: Implement computational overhead tracking for offline tree construction relative to total training time, performance gain vs. tree size analysis, and automated result aggregation generating LaTeX tables and performance comparison charts across all benchmarks and baselines.
